pages.name: Vovkulaka
pages.text: A huge black wolf the size of a horse.

pages.title: Wild
pages.text: Never attacks first, but watches you when you are within $(thing)10 blocks$(). Come close and it may pounce. Strong bite: $(thing)3 hearts$(). Very fast.

pages.title: Taming
pages.text: Feed it an $(item)enchanted golden apple$() (always works) or a $(item)golden apple$() (random chance per apple, like cats and dogs).$(br2)A tamed one helps in fights. Empty hand, right click: ride it (it steps up one block by itself); Shift + right click: tell it to sit or stand.
